Fig. 1.
Outline of the Taxol biosynthetic pathway illustrating the cyclization
of geranylgeranyl diphosphate to taxadiene, the hydroxylation to taxadien-
5-ol, acetylation to the ester, and subsequent 10-hydroxylation and 13-

signify undeﬁned steps.

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2.
CO-difference spectra recorded with solubilized microsomal protein
from S. fugiperda cells infected with recombinant A. californica baculovirus

gene (negative control, dotted line). For solubilization with Emulgen 911 (Kao

efﬁciency of about 50% was achieved.
